decisions.reason: Minimum quantity lubrication sits close to the firm's established coolant and fluid-handling expertise for machine-tool users, and its own R&D lets it interpret results and refine the product, so the missing archive pages are not evidence of withdrawal.

The hydrocyclone coolant filter builds directly on the firm's core filtration platforms, and its in-house R&D gives it strong absorptive capacity to improve the product, so it is very likely retained.
The gravity band coolant filter is a close modular extension of the firm's established filtration range, so its related knowledge and R&D support keeping and developing it.
